name: work-log
description: A daily work log written by itself: turn.start remembers the prompt, tool.call counts the tools it used, and turn.complete appends one Markdown line per turn to <logDir>/YYYY-MM-DD.md. /worklog prints today's file. Reads no tool arguments, only the tool names. Needs function hooks (early access).

logDir.title: Work log directory
logDir.description: Absolute path the daily YYYY-MM-DD.md files are written to. Left empty, the plugin writes into a worklog/ folder inside its own directory.
